correctness.rationale: The suffix transform y_i=sum_(j>=i)x_j−c_i is integral triangular of determinant one and uses x_i=b_i+y_i−y_(i+1) for i<n. Hence precisely the order-polytope cover and extremal-coordinate facets survive. Contraction of the cover or deletion of an extremum gives the indicated (n−1)-element order polytope with its full induced affine lattice. The primitive x-normal is a signed coordinate vector or suffix vector. Its norm is the covolume of the integer direction lattice: adjoining an integer vector pairing to one with the primitive normal gives determinant one and height the reciprocal of the norm. Thus the extension-count volumes acquire exactly the stated norm weights. For S={1}, the chain n≺n−1≺⋯≺2 has the extra element 1 constrained only below 2. There are n−1 insertions; cover contractions have counts 1 for contracting (1,2) and n−2 at each of the n−2 other covers. Deleting extrema 1,2,n gives counts 1,n−1,n−2. Reversal with order duality gives the mirrored data and affine unimodular map to T. The two weighted sums subtract to the claimed gap; its numerator is zero at n=3, positive at 4, and on t≥4 its derivative exceeds sqrt(2)−1−3/(4sqrt(t))>0. Cancellation of the leading radical terms gives (sqrt(2)−1)n+O(sqrt(n)) in the numerator. A fresh original-coordinate hull test checked all 60 profiles for n=3–6, all 474 individual facet hyperplanes and facet areas, and total area and volume, with reversal gaps 0, 0.0077480441, 0.0053745919, and 0.0019933096.
residual_risks: Fresh hull comparisons use SciPy/NumPy and floating-point geometry, with exact permutation counts. They only cover n=3–6 and do not substitute for the general proof. The measure is standard Euclidean in x, not in the transformed y metric.

value.rationale: The useful distinction is not the familiar possibility that a unimodular map changes Euclidean measures. It is the complete usable facet measure for a specified natural family, and a signed, exact, every-dimension separation of two natural reversed profiles that face-lattice and volume data cannot distinguish. The normal weights explain the mechanism and locate the first dimension where it occurs.
residual_risks: This establishes the reversal comparison for one natural pair, not an isoperimetric order of all profiles or any higher intrinsic-volume law.
